        if = { limit = { gold >= tsin_gold_cost_2 } change_gold_effect = { scale = -2 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = tsin_history_verified_practice years = 3 mode = replace } } else = { set_variable = { name = tsin_hist1_motor_stage value = 99 } }
        ai_chance = { factor = 4 }
    }
    option = {
        name = tsin_history_wave1.20.b
        set_variable = { name = tsin_hist1_motor_stage value = 99 }
        ai_chance = { factor = 1 }
    }
}
